annotations.title: Check an email against known data breaches

description: Checks whether an email address appears in known data breaches. Provide `email`. Returns the number of breaches found with the named sources behind each; a count of zero means no breaches were found in the corpus, not that the address is safe. Read-only: it only looks up breach records. Requires the RELAYSHIELD_API_KEY environment variable; without it, the tool returns setup instructions instead of calling the API.
name: check_breach
title: Check an email against known data breaches
